Full Feature Reference

Fighting Style

You adopt a particular style of fighting as your specialty.

Second Wind

You have a limited well of stamina that you can draw on.

Action Surge

You can push yourself beyond your normal limits for a moment.

Combat Superiority

You learn maneuvers that are fueled by superiority dice.

Ability Score Improvement

You can increase ability scores or choose a feat.

Extra Attack

You can attack more than once when taking the Attack action.

Know Your Enemy

You can study a creature to learn combat capabilities.

Indomitable

You can reroll a saving throw that you fail.

Improved Combat Superiority

Your superiority dice become stronger.

Extra Attack (2)

You can attack three times when taking the Attack action.

Indomitable (2)

You can use Indomitable twice between rests.

Relentless

You regain a superiority die when you have none.

Action Surge (2)

You can use Action Surge twice between rests.

Indomitable (3)

You can use Indomitable three times between rests.

Extra Attack (3)

You can attack four times when taking the Attack action.

Spells & Resources

No spells. Track Second Wind, Action Surge, Indomitable, and superiority dice.

Equipment & Inventory

Longsword, shield, chain mail, explorer's pack.

Character Story

Aria searches for the banner lost by her old company.
